speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon
text: asked the Minister for National Development whether the Ministry will consider extending HDB's deferred downpayment scheme to 4-room and 5-room BTO flats and to applicants with low income.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The balance flat price is then payable when they collect the keys.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: So, it is really meant for seniors to facilitate rightsizing.

speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
text: It is good to know that there is such a scheme to help young home owners.

speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
text: My question is: is the downpayment a form of credit protection?

speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
text: If it is a form of credit protection to ensure that the flat owner does not renege on his transaction, then would it be right to say that if he already has equity in his existing flat and HDB has control over the process of the sale of his existing flat and the purchase of his new flat?

speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
text: If HDB has control over all these things, would it be correct to say that his equity in his existing flat is sufficient downpayment and sufficient credit protection for the downpayment for his new flat?

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: Was the Member asking a specific question again?

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: So, the Member is asking whether we need a downpayment to begin with?

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: Zero downpayment for all purchases of all HDB flats?

speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon
text: I was referring to specific cases where there is an existing flat and the home owner is moving to another flat and HDB has control over both flats.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: As I mentioned earlier, we do have the SDS to help both young couples, as well as flat owners of all ages who are rightsizing.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: So, those are specific instances where we allow for staggered downpayment and, if there are other flat buyers who have difficulties, they can approach HDB and we can help them on a case-by-case basis.
